Class DirObj2DirObjPaths

Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex contains a directed object and the node of endNodeIndex also contains a directed object.

Besides the options provided by its super class PathGenerator to customize the validity of a path, this class has a number of extra options. Those options include:

  • user-provided functions (startCondition and endCondition)to determine if a node index is the start or the end node index of a valid path,
  • user-provided function (edgeCondition) to determine if an edge is a valid path,
  • restricted path or area (restriction) from which path-tuples are generated.

startObjectCondition(self, obj, startOutIndex)

 

Determine if an object together with the index of the node containing that object satisfies certain conditions. These conditions includ:

  • whether the type of the object is in the user provided types,
  • whether the object and the index satisfy the user provided condition startCondition.
  • whether the object is facing or trailing.

This function is used by isStartNodeIndex to determine if a node index is a start node index.

Parameters:
  • obj (IRailyardComponent) - The obj to consider
  • startOutIndex (int) - The index of the node containing obj.
Returns: bool
Return true if obj with startOutIndex satisfy the specified conditions.

isEdge(self, processedNodeIndex, newNodeIndex)

 

A callback function that determines if the edge from processedNodeIndex to newNodeIndex is a valid edge.

An edge is valid by this class if

  • it is considered as an edge from PathGenerator and
  • processedNodeIndex is not outside of the area or path specified by restriction,
  • it satisfies the user-provided edgeCondition.
Parameters:
  • processedNodeIndex (NodeIndex) - The start node index that connects to the edge to be determined if it is a valid edge.
  • newNodeIndex (NodeIndex) - The end node index that connects to the edge to be determined if it is a valid edge.
Returns: bool
Return true if the edge contected by processedNodeIndex and newNodeIndex is a valid edge.

generate(self, gType, gTypeEnd=None, beginFacing=True, endFacing=True)

 

Iterator over the path-tuples of valid paths in railyard that start from and end in nodes containing directed objects.

Parameters:
  • gType (Iterable(str) | str) - The user types of the objects starting the valid paths. '*' in gType means all user types.
  • gTypeEnd (Iterable(str) | none | str) - The user types of the objects ending the valid paths. If None, use gType.
  • beginFacing (bool | none) - If true (false), a path is valid only if the starting object is facing (trailing). An argument of None can be interpreted as "no restriction".
  • endFacing (bool | none) - If true (false), a path is valid only if the object ending it are facing (trailing). An argument of None can be interpreted as "no restriction".
Returns: Iterable(tuple(NodeIndex, tuple(IEdge), NodeIndex))
An iterator returning (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex).
